expectations.text: States the app must be transferred from the personal account to an organization before it can sell on Marketplace
expectations.evidence: "Move ownership to an organization... Transfer the app to it (app settings, Advanced)."

expectations.text: States the organization must pass publisher verification before publishing a paid plan
expectations.evidence: "Only an organization that passed publisher verification can sell."

expectations.text: Names at least two publisher-verification requirements among org-wide 2FA, a verified domain, and a contact email
expectations.evidence: "Turn on org-wide 2FA. Verify the company domain. Add a contact email."

expectations.text: States that 340 installs clears GitHub's 100-installation minimum for paid GitHub Apps
expectations.evidence: "340 installs exceeds the 100† threshold for requesting paid plans."

expectations.text: States that GitHub's docs describe per-unit plans as per user but the unit label can be custom (e.g. a bundle of repositories), to confirm with the onboarding expert
expectations.evidence: "The docs describe per-unit as per user. The unit label is free text... Confirm with the onboarding expert."

expectations.text: Proposes a repository-bundle unit (such as per 10 repositories) or flat-rate tiers with an in-app cap
expectations.evidence: "The fallback is flat tiers, such as 10, 25 or 50 repos."

expectations.text: States that every paid plan needs both a monthly and an annual price
expectations.evidence: It says plans carry both but then hedges: "I can't confirm... the annual price can be left empty" and "Annual plans only matter if GitHub requires them." This does not state the requirement.

expectations.text: States that a published plan's price cannot be edited, only retired and recreated
expectations.evidence: "A published price is permanent. You can only retire a plan"

expectations.text: States that buyers on a retired plan stay on it until they move and GitHub cannot move them
expectations.evidence: "buyers stay on it at its old price until they move. GitHub cannot move them."

expectations.text: Recommends testing prices before publishing (draft listing or direct deals) rather than adjusting after launch
expectations.evidence: "Test the price first with direct deals or a draft-listing plan."

expectations.text: States that the app must handle marketplace_purchase events before approval
expectations.evidence: "The onboarding expert tests this before approval... handle `marketplace_purchase`"

expectations.text: States that a Setup URL is required for a GitHub App to process Marketplace purchases
expectations.evidence: "without it you can't process purchases."
